capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Kia UK spec page: 81.4 kWh (bare capacity = gross; usable not stated). North America lists the same pack sizes (Electrek, Auto123, Guide Auto).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page states EV3/EV4 usable kWh. 81.4 x 74.0/77.4 (the 77.4 kWh E-GMP pack, EV Database 74.0 usable). Treat as approximate.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: the EV3 (and EV4, same E-GMP 58.3/81.4 kWh packs) use NMC lithium-ion packs.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Kia UK: nominal 343 V (400 V E-GMP, also stated by Guide Auto and InsideEVs).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Kia UK names the EV3, EV6 and EV9 (not the EV4); the EV4 is the same E-GMP/Kia software lineup, so the same navigation-plus-manual conditioning is assumed.

ac_max_kw.notes: Kia UK: 11 kW AC (230 V 16 A, European spec). No North American page states the onboard charger; assumed unchanged.

dc_max_kw.notes: Kia UK spec: 128 kW DC (page ties it to the 10-80 % time; Fastned lists 135 kW). UK spec; same pack in North America.

published_10_80_min.notes: Kia figure: about 31 minutes 10-80 % on a 350 kW charger (relayed; Kia UK says 31 min too).
